context:
Goal: the merge tool's batch flow runs without permission prompts.
Problem (rule): your Nov pick allows only --batch-build, --batch-drop and --ready, but the red-run steps also use --blame --run, --on and --base, which the allow entry does not cover, so the auto-mode check may refuse them.
Based on (ruling): your Nov pick to allow only the merge tool's --batch-build, --batch-drop and --ready flags without a prompt.
Departs from: main has no entry for these flags — this change allows the three you picked.

lastAnswer.note: Owner in coordinator chat, 13:40 CST Nov 12, relayed 13:40 CST: "b: also allow --blame --run, --on and --base. This widens past your pick."
